data.name: Codex-Named Unit (ability_inner_sea_gods_isg_abilities_faith_lst_382)
data.description: If you have performed your daily obedience, you are a talented healer, and have honed your ability so that you can preserve your resources while you provide aid to the wounded. You can channel positive energy by consuming a single use of your lay on hands ability instead of two uses. If you don't have the lay on hands class feature (or if you have lay on hands but can't use it to channel positive energy), you instead gain a +4 sacred bonus on Heal checks.
